text:
nina: Quick heads-up  spun up aurora13b (fp16 -> int8) in staging. Big token savings but some narrative recall regressions. Need a concise scorecard for GTN/PM.

omar: Paste the smoke numbers when you have them.

nina: smoke dump:
```
fp16 baseline: cost_per_token = $0.0115, p95 = 148ms, accept = 0.79
int8: cost_per_token = $0.0036, p95 = 162ms, accept = 0.66
recall_long (8k) = -10.2pp, recall_short (512) = -1.1pp
kv-cache hit rate ~78% on our trace
```

felix: ~3.2x token cost reduction. Where are the failures concentrated? omissions, hallucinations, or fluency?

nina: Mostly omissions and missing steps in multi-turn reasoning. Fluency OK. Hallucination small (<1pp). Short prompts mostly fine.

omar: Suggest hybrid: keep attention/kv ops fp16, rest int8. Ran a small microbench: recovered ~6pp recall, cost +18% vs pure int8.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary launched aurora13b-int8-hybrid in us-east-1 (1 GPU). dashboard: https://internal/dash/model/aurora13b/int8-hybrid

nina: kicked off 300-sample eval on labeled slices (longform-heavy). ETA ~4h.

felix: For GTN include unit-econ table (avg_tokens = 400/800/1600). Also show savings per request and monthly impact.

omar: quick calc:
```
avg_t = 800
delta_pp = 0.0115 - 0.0036 = 0.0079
savings_per_req = avg_t * delta_pp = $6.32
```

felix: If a quality drop reduces conversion on critical flows, that $6+ saving can be offset. Need product-provided conv sensitivity.

nina: Drafting scorecard fields now: [variant, cost_per_token, p95_latency, recall_long_pp, recall_short_pp, accept_delta_pp, recommended_route, rollout_gates].

omar: Rollout gate proposal: recall_long >= -7pp AND hallucination_increase <= 1pp over 24h; else holdback. Add auto-rollback if accept_delta > 4pp over rolling 12h.

ops-bot: eval-run complete (300 samples)  results: https://internal/evals/aurora13b/300

nina: TL;DR from eval: int8 recall_long = -8.7pp, hallucination +0.9pp, accept_drop = 5.2pp. hybrid recall_long = -2.5pp, hallucination +0.6pp, accept_drop = 1.8pp. p95 latency +/- 10-20ms.

felix: Based on this: recommend mixed fleet. Default hybrid for mid/long outputs (>700 tokens), pure int8 for short/snippets, fp16 reserved for critical creator flows. Draft one-pager for GTN with cost sims and break-even scenarios.

omar: I'll prepare A/B plan (2k sample) and routing flag specs.

nina: created ticket INF-2581 to track canary, eval CSV, and scorecard. Attaching sample failures.

felix: LGTM. Note: 300-sample is noisy; large A/B required before a full traffic shift. :thumbsup:
